msg: The whole point of the game is there are two types of forests, light and dark. It seems during play that the forest with the most mushrooms changes every so often. Red, orange,green and blue gnomes lead to the bright forest. Brown, pink, yellow and purple gnomes lead to the dark forest.The position or size of the gnomes don't matter, just experiment early and figure out where you are getting the most mushrooms and if you get less good results after a while try the other forest to see if you're just unlucky or if the other forest has become more bountiful.
